description: RLS policies for SILENCE. All tables have RLS enabled. Policies use auth.uid() from Supabase JWT.

policies.description: Users can read their own record; admins can read all users (for member management); anyone can insert (signup).

policies.name: Users can view own profile
policies.using: auth.uid() = id

policies.name: Admins can view all users (for member lists)
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Users can update own profile
policies.using: auth.uid() = id
policies.with_check: auth.uid() = id

policies.name: Anyone can insert (signup)
policies.with_check: true

policies.name: No delete for regular users
policies.using: false

policies.description: Anyone can view active libraries. Only owner can insert/update/delete.

policies.name: Anyone can view active libraries
policies.using: status = 'active' OR status = 'setup' OR owner_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Only owner can insert
policies.with_check: auth.uid() = owner_id

policies.name: Only owner can update
policies.using: auth.uid() = owner_id
policies.with_check: auth.uid() = owner_id

policies.name: Only owner can delete (only if status = 'setup')
policies.using: auth.uid() = owner_id AND status = 'setup'

policies.description: Only library owner can manage shifts.

policies.name: Admins can manage shifts of their libraries
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Anyone can view shifts (for explore/join)
policies.using: true

policies.description: Library owner can manage floors.

policies.name: Owner full access
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Read only for others
policies.using: true

policies.description: Same as floors.

policies.name: Owner full access
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM floors JOIN libraries ON floors.library_id = libraries.id WHERE floors.id = floor_id AND libraries.owner_id = auth.uid())
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM floors JOIN libraries ON floors.library_id = libraries.id WHERE floors.id = floor_id AND libraries.owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Read only for others
policies.using: true

policies.description: Anyone can view seats; only owner can update status.

policies.name: Anyone can view seats
policies.using: true

policies.name: Owner can update seats (status, occupied_by, maintenance)
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Owner can insert/delete
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Owner can delete
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.description: Members can view their own; admins can view all members of their libraries; system can insert/update.

policies.name: Member view own memberships
policies.using: member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin view all memberships of their libraries
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Admin insert (add member manually)
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Admin update (approve, renew, hold, transfer)
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: System can update (auto-hold, auto-expiry)
policies.using: true
policies.with_check: true
policies.note: Use service_role key for scheduled jobs

policies.description: Members can view own; admins can view all of their libraries; members can insert (check-in/out).

policies.name: Member view own attendance
policies.using: member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin view all attendance of their libraries
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Member insert (check-in/out)
policies.with_check: member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin insert (manual check-in)
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Admin update (edit session duration)
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.description: Members can view own; admins can view all of their libraries; members can insert (UPI proof); admin can update status.

policies.name: Member view own payments
policies.using: member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin view all payments of their libraries
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Member insert (upload proof)
policies.with_check: member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin update status (confirm/reject/dispute)
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.using: member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin view requests for their libraries

policies.name: Member insert new request
policies.with_check: member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin update (approve/reject)

policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.description: Members can view their own; admins can view for their libraries; members can insert; admin can update.

policies.name: Member view own
policies.using: member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin view
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Member insert
policies.with_check: member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin update
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.description: Similar to seat_change_requests.

policies.name: Member view own
policies.using: member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin view
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Member insert
policies.with_check: member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin update
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.description: Only admin can insert (create transfer). Members can view their own transfers.

policies.name: Member view own transfers
policies.using: member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin view
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE from_library_id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid()) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE to_library_id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Admin insert
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE from_library_id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.description: Only library owner can manage add-ons; anyone can view.

policies.name: Anyone can view
policies.using: true

policies.name: Owner can insert/update/delete
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.description: Members can view their own; admin can view all.

policies.name: Member view own
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships WHERE id = membership_id AND member_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Admin view
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM add_ons JOIN libraries ON add_ons.library_id = libraries.id WHERE add_ons.id = add_on_id AND libraries.owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Admin insert/update
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM add_ons JOIN libraries ON add_ons.library_id = libraries.id WHERE add_ons.id = add_on_id AND libraries.owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.description: Members can view their own referrals; admin can view all referrals for their libraries.

policies.name: Member view own referrals (as referrer or referred)
policies.using: referrer_member_id = auth.uid() OR referred_member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin view
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: System insert (via join flow)
policies.with_check: true

policies.description: Members can view their own; admin can view all.

policies.name: Member view own badges
policies.using: member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin view badges of members in their libraries
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships WHERE memberships.member_id = badges.member_id AND library_id = badges.library_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = memberships.library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid()))

policies.name: System insert (auto-earn)
policies.with_check: true

policies.description: Admin can manage announcements; members can view.

policies.name: Admin insert
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Admin update/delete
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: Members can view announcements of their libraries
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships WHERE memberships.library_id = announcements.library_id AND memberships.member_id = auth.uid())

policies.description: Members can mark reads; admin can view read status.

policies.name: Member insert own read
policies.with_check: member_id = auth.uid()

policies.name: Admin view reads

policies.name: User update read_at
policies.using: user_id = auth.uid()
policies.with_check: user_id = auth.uid()

policies.description: Only admin (owner) can view audit log for their libraries.

policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

policies.name: System insert

policies.description: Admin can manage closures; members can view.

policies.name: Admin full access
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM libraries WHERE id = library_id AND owner_id = auth.uid())

notes: All tables must have `ALTER TABLE table_name ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;` executed.
Service role key (service_role) is used for scheduled jobs (auto-checkout, auto-hold, expiry notifications).
For real-time subscriptions, policies still apply.
Indexes are defined in the database schema file (04_Database_Schema.json).
